title: Jets QB Geno Smith out for Friday's preseason game vs. Buccaneers with foot soreness

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets QB Geno Smith out for Friday's preseason game vs. Buccaneers with foot soreness
sources.description: Jets QB Geno Smith will not play in the team's first preseason game on Friday against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers due to foot soreness.
